_about: Regulatory decisions that are newer than, or add to, the EFSA references in additives.json. Each entry is checked by scripts/verify-regulatory.mjs: the DOI must exist in Crossref with a matching title, or the page must contain every phrase in 'must_contain'. Only verified entries are used by the app.

entries.title: Safety assessment of titanium dioxide (E171) as a food additive
entries.summary: EFSA concluded that titanium dioxide (E171) can no longer be considered safe as a food additive, because concerns about genotoxicity could not be ruled out.
must_contain: no longer be considered safe as a food additive

entries.title: Aspartame hazard and risk assessment results released
entries.summary: IARC classified aspartame as possibly carcinogenic to humans (Group 2B), based on limited evidence. JECFA kept the acceptable daily intake at 40 mg/kg body weight. A hazard classification describes whether something could cause cancer, not how likely it is at normal intakes.
